title: Prospective study on the Assessment and Clinical Significance of Hypoxic Burden as a Novel Parameter in Ambulatory Sleep Diagnostics using Peripheral Arterial Tonometry
summary: Investigation of a potentially more informative index than the apnea-hypopnea index (AHI) in patients with obstructive sleep apnea syndrome (OSAS) using peripheral arterial tonometry (PAT) and incorporating relevant questionnaires for the diagnosis of OSAS

interventions.name: Patients undergo peripher arterial tonometry and are assessed using the ESS, STOP-Bang and ISI

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients aged 18 years or older who have provided informed consent for the use of their data for scientific research purposes
Exclusion criteria:
Incomplete dataset
Technical artifacts / technical disturbances
Refusal to allow the use of data for research purposes
